name: The last Idoma leave Igala land

summary.text: Between about 1700 and 1740 the last Idoma living in Igala land moved east and founded most of present-day Ogbadibo and Okpokwu. From about 1740 the Idoma paid tribute to Idah, the seat of the Attah and the spiritual capital of the Igala.

routes.label: The last Idoma leave Igala land for Ogbadibo and Okpokwu

moments.title: Idah, spiritual capital of the Igala
moments.text: Idah, the seat of the Attah and the spiritual capital of the Igala, receives tribute from the Idoma.

note: Dates and routes follow one published timeline of Idoma history; Idoma clans tell their migrations in many versions.
reviewNotes: Owner correction (2026-10-08): Idah is the spiritual capital of the Igala, not of the Idoma. The earlier draft followed one reading of the Idoma timeline.
